items.title: "Papa Jack" Laine and Mrs. "Papa Jack" Laine Interview, 1960-05-23

ctx.x: No, no. No one. That's a drum and bugle. Adolph never played with me. No. No. Here's something I organized, reorganized in 1936. I built that hook and ladder. And it's standing out there today in the yard. It's right there standing out in the yard.
Is that the one that's up at the protection levee?
